name: Memory (Cloudflare Vectorize)
description: Long-term memory with Cloudflare Vectorize + Workers AI. Seamless auto-recall and auto-capture.

workerUrl.description: URL of the memory worker. Defaults to OPENCLAW_MEMORY_WORKER_URL when omitted.

workerToken.description: Bearer token for protected memory worker endpoints. Defaults to OPENCLAW_MEMORY_WORKER_TOKEN when omitted.

autoRecall.description: Automatically recall relevant memories before agent starts

autoCapture.description: Automatically capture important info after agent ends

recallLimit.description: Max memories to inject on auto-recall

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.description: Inject relevant memories before agent runs

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.description: Store important info after agent runs
